title: ssh/key identity
description: An SSH key, its enrollment with an authority, and the environment that makes tools use it.

authority.description: Who vouches for the key. self means nobody does; github registers it on the account the upstream token belongs to.

store.description: Where the key is held. secure-enclave is macOS hardware; file is an ordinary key file and is not hardware-protected.

allow.description: What the key may do. It limits the identity's agent socket and decides what is enrolled.

require.description: What must hold for the key to be used. The only term is unlocked. It is fixed when the key is created.

user.description: The SSH login name on the remote side. Set as ANSIBLE_REMOTE_USER when authentication is allowed.

key.description: The key's name in the store. Defaults to the identity's name. Identities that share a key must agree on store and require.

rewrite_https.description: Hosts whose HTTPS Git URLs are rewritten to SSH.

root.description: The plugin's data directory, when it is not the default. The plugin cannot see Atmos's environment, so a relocated Atmos data directory must be named here.

require.description: The file store cannot enforce any requirement. Use secure-enclave for require: unlocked.
